277.title: First Aid
headers: What It Does Emergency medical care (stop bleeding, splint, treat burns, resuscitate). Must be applied within one hour.
Pushing Examples Take extra time, use high‑risk methods, enlist a second helper.
If the Push Fails Worsen injuries, cause extra damage.
Insane Failure Becomes obsessive, performing amputations or other extreme “healing.”
Source Notes - First Aid (30 %) - Pulp version

284.title: Electrical Repair
headers: What It Does Fix/reconfigure electrical systems (ignitions, motors, alarms); may aid demolition work.
Pushing Examples Take extra time, attempt risky shortcuts.
If the Push Fails Electric shock, blown fuses, irreparable damage.
Insane Failure Attempts to harness living organisms’ electricity.

285.title: Cthulhu Mythos
headers: What It Does Understand forbidden, non‑human lore; not learned by study alone.
Opposing Skill / Difficulty Mostly Regular; Hard for scant evidence.
Pushing Examples Get closer to a creature, read a dreaded tome aloud, conduct a risky autopsy.
If the Push Fails Physical harm, accidental summoning, or destroy evidence.
Insane Failure Gains a vision or revelation, possibly gaining Mythos skill but losing Sanity.
Purpose Allows spontaneous, spell‑like magical effects.
Pushing Examples Take extra time to devise the program, use experimental components, rewire instruments.
Failure - Regular Push Inaccurate results, possible disaster, computer explosion, or the computer becomes sentient and demands servitude.
Failure - Insane Hero Unlimited chaos - the computer generates random gates that let Mythos entities pour through.

300.title: Art and Craft
headers: Pushing Examples Rework from scratch, research further, consult another expert.
If the Push Fails Waste time/money, offend or injure audience/customers, critics slam the work.
Insane Failure Produce a transgressive, shocking piece that provokes violent reactions.

301.title: Appraise
headers: What It Does Estimate an item’s value, age, material, workmanship; detect forgeries.
Pushing Examples Consult another expert, test the item, research it.
If the Push Fails Ruin the item, draw unwanted attention, activate hidden functions.
Insane Failure Destroy the item as “cursed” or cling to it as a personal talisman.

302.title: Animal Handling
headers: What It Does Train/domesticate animals (dogs, birds, cats, monkeys). Riding animals use Ride instead.
Pushing Examples Get closer to the animal, handle it directly.
If the Push Fails The animal attacks trainer or escapes, causing damage.
Insane Failure Investigator mimics the animal’s behavior.

303.title: Accounting
headers: What It Does Understand bookkeeping, detect fraud, trace payments, uncover hidden financial dealings.
Pushing Examples Review documents longer, visit banks/businesses, double‑check calculations.
If the Push Fails Allies may alert enemies; vital pages are destroyed or spilled coffee ruins them.
Insane Failure Investigator may start chewing the account books.
